row: Synergy Horsemanship & Happy Valley Horse Rescue

Synergy Horsemanship is a punishment-free form of interaction with a horse. Positive reinforcement and the most drama/stress-free we can make the learning and communication process. Together with Criadero El Ocaso Farm & Happy Valley Horse Rescue, we strive to teach people the natural way of communicating with horses to reach your goals whatever they may be alongside your equine partner.
